configure_report_sink: configure the report sink with output format, report path, and verbosity level
add_record_to_report_sink: add an output record to the report sink for stdout and file output
close_report_sink: close the report sink and release the report file handle
get_report_sink_verbosity: get the current verbosity level of the report sink
get_report_sink_path: get the report file path configured on the report sink
